notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
description:
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Electro.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Firebending Student
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
